pre_result_data_quality_amendment: After downloading spot and quarterly series but before any signal or PnL computation, both BTC and ETH spot archives were found to omit exactly 2023-03-24 13:00 UTC from H1 and 1m data. Binance's public incident notice confirms a venue-wide spot halt. No price is invented: a missing spot mark is omitted from portfolio-MTM sampling while the complete futures series continues to drive collateral risk. Every feature, entry and planned exit timestamp still requires real spot and futures observations; otherwise that expiry cannot execute. A triggered risk exit uses the first subsequent common tradable H1 open. No signal, threshold, sizing, cost or risk parameter changed.
hypothesis: A positive fixed-expiry futures premium can be locked with equal-quantity long spot and short quarterly USD-M futures, avoiding uncertain perpetual funding and cross-venue transfers.

capital.futures_short_quantity: exactly equal base-asset quantity to the spot long

schedule.expiry_definition: Last Friday of March, June, September and December at 08:00 UTC
schedule.decision: Exactly 30 days before expiry at 08:00 UTC using only the H1 spot and CURRENT_QUARTER futures bar completed at 08:00
schedule.entry: At the 09:00 UTC H1 open on the decision day
schedule.planned_exit: At the 07:00 UTC H1 open one hour before expiry, avoiding delivery mechanics and continuous-series roll
schedule.selection: Choose BTC or ETH with the larger known entry premium; deterministic BTC tie-break
schedule.qualification: CURRENT_QUARTER premium over spot must be at least 1.00% and annualized simple premium at least 12.00%; otherwise hold cash for the quarter
schedule.duplicate_control: At most one trade per quarterly expiry

risk.risk_exit: At the next common tradable H1 open if futures equity falls below $100 or futures mark leverage exceeds 0.80x
risk.no_rebalancing: No transfer from spot proceeds or reserve to rescue the short; no leverage increase, martingale or averaging
risk.end_of_window: Close both legs at the last common real H1 open

data.source: Anonymous public Binance Data Vision spot H1 archives with published checksums and public USD-M CURRENT_QUARTER continuous H1 klines; no account or API key
data.missing_policy: No interpolation, forward-fill, proxy price or synthetic execution. A missing H1 spot observation may use only the exact same timestamp from a checksum-verified public Binance spot 1m archive. A verified venue-halt spot gap is retained and omitted from portfolio-MTM sampling while futures collateral remains evaluated hourly. Missing feature, entry or exit observations cancel that expiry; any futures-series gap rejects the replay.
data.continuous_contract_limit: The position exits before the expiry/roll boundary. No PnL is allowed to cross the continuous-series roll.

windows.genuine_oos: quarterly opportunities after 2026-09-01 under the unchanged protocol

historical_gate: stress net PnL >0 in every window
at least 2 executed expiries in development, validation and retrospective evaluation
zero collateral exhaustion, minimum futures equity >=$100 and maximum futures mark leverage <=0.80x
both BTC and ETH must either contribute positive stress PnL or the strategy is concentration-rejected
paper_gate: Historical pass permits paper-forward only. Live requires at least 8 prospective quarterly observations, which implies approximately two years, with positive stress PnL and observed basis/costs inside assumptions.
limitations: The current-quarter continuous series must not silently roll before the stated boundary; every trade is audited around expiry.
H1 bars do not model order-book depth, outage or liquidation-engine tiers.
Expected returns are low and cannot credibly produce $25/day on $250.
